messages.text: Production and supplier operations needs one defensible decision for outside operation completion by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside operation completion cannot exceed accepted returned quantity.
I found 130 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for next internal operation capacity is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
